elbow_flex.source: Cable single-arm triceps pushdown guides (fitnessprogramer, endomondo): start with the elbow at a 90-degree angle, upper arm parallel to the floor; push down until the arm is fully extended but not locked out (10 degrees, matching the lateral raise's illustrative not-locked-out convention)

shoulder_flex.source: Triceps pushdown form guides (deltabolic, triceps.info): the upper arm is a hinge bolted to the torso and stays vertical for the whole rep, pinned to the side

torso_lean.source: Tricep pushdown mistake guides (otfworkouttoday, gravitus): stand upright with minimal lean

muscles.peakSource: Single-arm cable pushdown guides: pause briefly at the bottom and squeeze the triceps to maximize engagement there, so effort is highest in that hold just after full extension

mistake.name: Flare and lean

tells.text: The elbow drifts forward off the ribs instead of staying pinned.
The torso leans into it, using body weight to help push down.

mistake.source: Tricep pushdown mistake guides (otfworkouttoday, gravitus, deltabolic): letting the elbow flare/drift forward shifts load from the triceps to the shoulder and chest; leaning over the cable to add body weight turns the pushdown into a full-body press

sources: Contact fact (D-FG7 (e), the single-arm id): a single D-handle at the high pulley, one hand (fitnessprogramer, endomondo one-arm cable pushdown guides)
